content: Yesterday we published docs for how to add stylesheets and custom page handlers in BonBon. This morning, Joseph Fieber published a stylesheet that makes BonBon work better in dark mode. This is a sign of things working. The goal is to boot up a self-sufficient community of writers and developers who help each other build the kind of network they want. The web, in its first years, before it was taken over by big companies, used to work this way. We're determined to see it work that way again.
